categories.distribution: Canonical Workflow implementation. Copied byte-for-byte into the payload and installed into every managed target repository.

rules.rationale: D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TOOLING_AMBIENT_EXCLUDED_PATHS = {.workflow-manager/installation.json}, an exact-path, release-derived terminal fallback that classify_path and classify_path_implementation_stage consult only after every declared classification has failed, immediately before the UnclassifiedPathError raise. The frozen declared-classification semantics are untouched: a declaration still decides first, the constant never enters a hashed classification set, and the path never existed in any Workflow payload or in the upstream repository the frozen classifier was written for -- so every digest 2.5.1 could compute is byte-identical and only a digest that raised because a committed workflow_manager update rewrote the installation record now returns (the legacy-item half of v2.4.0-001).

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TestToolingAmbientExcludedPaths -- fallback classification at both stages with a 2.5.1 control arm, explicit-protected precedence, sibling fail-closed paths, hashed-projection invariance, and digest invariance with the previously raising digests equal to their pre-update recorded values. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TestImplementingEntryReachableAfterInstallationRecordUpdate -- a 2.3.1-shaped item stays implementing_entry_reachable after a committed installation-record change, with a 2.5.1 control arm that raises UnclassifiedPathError. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): the Computing review_content_id section gains the classification paragraph naming the one release-derived fallback, where it sits in the classification order, and what stays fail-closed. D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): "Bundle structure" restates AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch to the working-tree anchor -- the base-plus-current-plus-declaration pathspec union, --no-renames, the provenance preamble, and its placement after MANIFEST.md -- and states it stays convenience only.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): new design section carrying the problem, the decision, its release-derived authority, the identity-stability argument, the fail-closed boundary, the justification relative to the frozen plan-stage classifier, and the rejected alternatives. D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): the section's AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch paragraph gains a "Working-tree anchor" subsection -- why the ..HEAD form was always empty, the pathspec union and its reachable deletion/rename shapes, the provenance preamble, and consistency with the reviewed bytes.

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2, v2.4.0-003): the AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch block drops ..HEAD and diffs amendment_base_commit against the working tree (--no-renames), over the sorted union of the plan_stage.protected_paths declared at amendment_base_commit, the ones declared now and <id>-artifacts.json itself; it gains a provenance preamble (work_item_id, amendment_id, amendment_base_commit, plan_revision, review_content_id) and moves after --write-manifest so the preamble can carry the manifest's review_content_id. The file stays outside current/ and outside both identities; the archive line and every other block are unchanged.

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): adds TestPrepareAiReviewShAmendmentDiffWorkingTreeAnchor, driving the real prepare-ai-review.sh in scratch repositories -- uncommitted plan edit (with a ..HEAD control arm), untracked new protected file with the index restored, dropped-and-deleted path, rename as deletion plus new file, dropped-but-kept changed and unchanged paths, artifacts declaration absent at the base, non-protected edits absent, archive member byte-identity, bundle_id invariance, removal after resolution, preamble fields, and git apply --check at amendment_base_commit. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified.

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): step 4's note on AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch states the working-tree anchor, so the patch shows the still-uncommitted amended plan. The generator-mention wording workflow_integration_test.py's census pins (mention-only, no run/rerun invocation) is kept.
